ggml 0.29.0 (upstream commit 57e2c2ca2a7cae756b1c4dfafa0cdfef9051d234, 2026-11-04), built as 0.0.0-stz

Taken 2026-11-12 over 0.15.3 (pinned 2026-11-11, RADAR-NVIDIA-GGMLPIN-01). Of the 100 files here other than this one,
92 are byte for byte the files at the same paths in tag v0.29.0; the four NOTICE names as patched carry the same
patches re-applied, and src/ggml-cpu/tiled/tiled.cpp carries one of its own (the tiled matmul off by default); NOTICE and this folder's own .gitignore are ours; and src/ggml-version.h is ours too, standing in
for the header upstream's CMake writes from ggml-version.h.in (it defines GGML_VERSION and GGML_COMMIT only where the
build has not). The four files of src/ggml-cpu/tiled/ and that header were missing from the first commit of 0.29.0
(ee2663143), which was made from a diff, and a diff carries no new file: a clean checkout could not build stz_neural
or stz_matrix until they were added the same day. The pruning is unchanged: CPU only,
x86 only, as NOTICE describes. Upstream's history between the two tags was read from a local clone of
github.com/ggml-org/ggml.

GGML_VERSION/GGML_COMMIT stay defined as 0.0.0-stz / stz at build time: a patched, pruned CPU build is not upstream's
0.29.0, and neural_runtime_narrated.ring reads that name.
